description: Conformance vectors for the ch.moltrust.deposit.* constraint types. Each case: mandate, planned transfer, history and evidence in; disposition and reason out. Field names per the public draft schema; see docs/deposit-constraints-vi-mapping.md.

conventions.evidence: Each evidence entry becomes one signed AER statement. source_id is did:moltrust:test-<source>, signed with the deterministic test key of tests/conftest.py (source_key), nonce n-<index>, window default_window unless valid_from/valid_until are given. The bundle is built with build_bundle(items, mandate, transfer, trigger_time).
conventions.bundle: Absent: build as above when evidence is given, pass None otherwise. omit: pass None. decision_timestamp: build with that timestamp instead of trigger_time. bind_transfer: build bound to that transfer instead.
conventions.expect: disposition and reason must match exactly; constraint_type when given.
